# Backup: Marble Skill Taxonomy

Vendored snapshot of a third-party open dataset, kept here as a durable backup.

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy.git
- **Commit backed up:** `96a7933754af672e1bfdbf7ecb05c325860c6e0d` (dataset v1.0.0, released 2026-07-08)
- **Backed up:** 2026-07-09

This is an unmodified copy (the upstream `.git` history was dropped; everything
else is byte-for-byte). It is **not** authored by this project. Its own licenses
apply — see `LICENSE` (ODbL 1.0, database), `LICENSE-CONTENT` (CC BY-SA 4.0,
text), and `PROVENANCE.md` (per-curriculum upstream terms). Any use must carry
the attribution in `README.md`.
